items.title: Ex-Flipkart execs press Walmart to buy out their stock options
items.description: With no visibility regarding the timing of any Flipkart initial public offering, the group of eight former C-suite and senior executives said a purchase of their shares by Walmart would allow them to liquidate their holdings.

items.title: GST Council proposes 5% levy on e-commerce delivery services, with no input tax credit
items.description: The clarification is aimed at bringing uniformity in the tax treatment of e-commerce deliveries and removes ambiguity over the applicability of GST when goods are transported through different channels

items.title: Air India, Air India Express hike fuel surcharge on domestic, international flights from October 9
items.description: Air India and Air India Express have revised their one-way domestic fuel surcharge, with the levy ranging from Rs 400 to Rs 1,200 depending on the flight distance.

items.title: Samsung flags $80 billion profit on AI boom, highest quarterly for any tech company
items.description: The world's largest memory chipmaker estimated an operating profit of 107.4 trillion won ($80.17 billion) for the July-September period, slightly ahead of an LSEG SmartEstimate of 106.1 trillion won.

items.title: Goldman says AI shift leaves middle managers in limbo
items.description: The shift threatens to upend the traditional career path, where analysts spend years running financial models and building presentations before taking on management responsibilities.

items.title: How AI is crowding out fresh graduates at Wall Street tech hubs in India
items.description: AI is upending labor markets around the world, yet few countries have as much at stake as India, long considered a nation of coders

items.title: Chart of the Day | Prolonged summer to drive a rebound in AC sales in FY2027
items.description: Room AC sales are likely to sizzle, but profit expansion hinges on commodity costs and indigenisation efforts by manufacturers

items.title: Car discounts rise even as prices climb, dealers face margin squeeze on record inventory
items.description: Rising discounts and higher vehicle prices are squeezing dealer margins as passenger vehicle inventory reaches a near one-year high ahead of the festive season

items.title: Flipkart's The Big Billion Days: Behind India’s biggest shopping festival
BPCL, Shell, Tiki Tar form JV to tap India's value-added bitumen market
items.description: The new company, Bharat Tiki Tar Shell Pvt Ltd, has begun operations following a joint venture and share subscription agreement signed on June 26, BPCL said in a statement

items.title: Ola Electric fixes Rs 27 price for Rs 1,000 crore rights issue, 26% below market price
items.description: The record date has been fixed as October 13, 2026, to determine shareholders eligible to receive rights entitlements.

items.title: CoreWeave tees up first India data centers with AdaniConneX deal
items.description: CoreWeave will use 240 megawatts of capacity at AdaniConneX Pvt.’s Taloja campus in Navi Mumbai, with an option to double that amount, the company said in a statement Wednesday.

items.title: IATA backs government intervention on Mumbai airport flight shift, calls for airline consultation
items.description: IATA has backed the government’s intervention, calling for a transparent capacity assessment and consultation with airlines before changes to flight operations linked to Mumbai airport’s T1 redevelopment

items.title: Quanfluence raises $10 million to build full-stack quantum computer
items.description: Pi Ventures, which led the company's seed round in 2024, participated in the latest round, while Rainmatter by Zerodha also invested.

items.title: Will RBI's change in stance dent the fragile sentiment of Indian equities?
items.description: Rate hike was expected, but a hawkish tone raises the risk of a deeper tightening cycle if inflation stays elevated

items.title: Why Mahindra isn't worried about Volkswagen's proposed alliance with JSW
items.description: Volkswagen supplies key EV components to Mahindra even as it explores a broader partnership with JSW, raising questions over how the two relationships would work if the proposed alliance deepens

items.title: Marsons to form JV with US-based Cleanhill Partners to tap North American market
items.description: Under the arrangement, the joint venture will combine Marsons' manufacturing capabilities with Cleanhill's capital and project network, with a longer-term plan to establish full-scale transformer manufacturing facilities in North America

items.title: Paramount wraps up mega Warner Bros merger to create Hollywood powerhouse Skydance
items.description: The deal brings together the studios behind "Mission: Impossible," "Harry Potter" and DC Studios alongside major television and streaming networks such as CBS, CNN, Paramount+ and HBO Max — forming an expansive entertainment company spanning film, TV and news.

items.title: ASK Alternates raises Rs 500 crore for second private credit fund
items.description: The money has been raised within five months of the launch of the fund, which has a target corpus of Rs 1,000 crore, a company statement said.

items.title: Google, Constellation Energy strike seal for nuclear power
items.description: The agreement is for 890 megawatts of new power coming online, the companies said in a statement on Tuesday

items.title: Adani Airports launches 80-room transit hotel at Navi Mumbai airport
items.description: The new airport hotel caters to passengers facing long layovers, early departures and late arrivals, with short-stay accommodation and round-the-clock dining

items.title: Govt asks Adani Airports to defer plan to shift international flights to Navi Mumbai
items.description: The aviation ministry has sought a fresh roadmap for Mumbai airport’s T1 redevelopment after airlines raised concerns over the proposed shift of international operations to Navi Mumbai

items.title: PepsiCo, Monster, Reliance win reprieve on 'energy drink' label ban in India
items.description: The regulator in June ordered makers of high-caffeine beverages sold ​as "energy drinks" to stop using the description, rejecting the industry's efforts to stall the move in a market expected to be worth $1.6 billion by 2028.

items.title: Krasha to launch India-focused litigation finance platform
items.description: Krasha is also preparing its proposed Category-II Alternative Investment Fund, Prism Strategy, targeting approximately US$60–70 million, subject to regulatory approvals and investor participation.

items.title: Insurance brokers push back against IRDAI's commission cap plan, write to PM and FM
items.description: IRDAI floated the proposals in a discussion paper in late September, with stakeholder feedback due by October 25
